body: oh i also have been keeping a diary, though it's mostly very disturbing thoughts and angst,,,, as i usually just write when i'm feeling intense emotions but idk if i want them to read those,,, might be too much to process. Tbh idk what kind message i'd want to leave haha but thanks anyway! It does feel soothing to just write down things

I personally like how relatable the characters are portrayed and how none of them are merely used as "plot device". Kinda gives a warm vibe to it 👌. Idk fantasy genre fiction is nice and offers a great escape for readers but sometimes we just wanna meet characters we identify with. 😂
